codeReview.summary: The worker delivered a narrow rename of OrchestrationSessionContext → SessionContext across ws/ and test files, plus three static-analysis-style tests. While this satisfies VAL-WS-003 and the no-import checks for VAL-WS-001 and VAL-FACTORY-002, two core requirements of the feature were not implemented: (1) simplified event types were never introduced (VAL-WS-002 unmet), and (2) factory.py was not updated to construct the new FleetAgent from runtime/agent/agent.py. The feature's own verification steps did not include a check for simplified event types, so the worker's validation commands all passed despite the gap.

issues.description: VAL-WS-002 NOT SATISFIED: The streaming layer still emits 'trajectory_step', 'reasoning_step', 'final', 'cancelled', 'assistant_token', 'hitl_request', etc. The feature description requires simplified event types only: status, text, reasoning, tool_call, tool_result, warning, error, done. None of 'text', 'reasoning', or 'done' exist in StreamEventKind. The old complex event taxonomy (defined in src/fleet_rlm/runtime/models/streaming.py lines defining StreamEventKind) was never simplified. No attempt was made to map or replace these event kinds.

Factory.py not updated to FleetAgent: The feature description says 'Update factory.py to construct the new FleetAgent.' factory.py still imports and uses RLMReActChatAgent from fleet_rlm.runtime.agent.chat_agent. The new FleetAgent class (defined in src/fleet_rlm/runtime/agent/agent.py) and its AgentRuntime (runtime/agent/runtime.py) were created in milestone 1 but factory.py was never rewired to use them. The worker verified only that factory.py had no agent_host/worker imports — it did not update factory.py to use the new simplified agent.

test_factory_produces_callable_agent is a weak assertion: it only checks callable(_factory.build_chat_agent), not that build_chat_agent returns a FleetAgent instance or any FleetAgent-derived type. This test passes even with the wrong agent class, masking the factory.py rewiring gap.

No test for VAL-WS-002 (simplified event types). The feature's 'fulfills' list includes VAL-WS-002 but the worker never wrote a test asserting that only simplified kinds are emitted, nor modified the event emission code. VAL-WS-002 is unverifiable from the test suite.

sharedStateObservations.observation: src/fleet_rlm/AGENTS.md Package Map section still lists 'agent_host/' and 'worker/' as active package areas even though both directories were deleted in the precondition feature (delete-agent-host-worker). This misleads future workers.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: src/fleet_rlm/AGENTS.md: '- agent_host/: Microsoft Agent Framework outer host...' and '- worker/: ...' appear in the Package Map section. Both directories no longer exist on disk.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The backend-refactor skill's TDD step says 'Write tests first (TDD). For new modules, write failing tests before implementation.' The worker wrote verification-style assertion tests after the fact rather than behavioral tests that would have caught the VAL-WS-002 gap. If a failing test for simplified event types had been written first, the missing implementation would have been obvious.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: All three tests added check import-absence or callability — none test runtime behavior. VAL-WS-002 (simplified event types) is a behavioral requirement that was listed in the feature's expectedBehavior and fulfills list but has no corresponding test.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The feature's verificationSteps did not include a check for simplified event types (VAL-WS-002), even though the feature lists VAL-WS-002 in its 'fulfills' array. The verification steps only covered OrchestrationSessionContext absence and factory import cleanliness. Future features that include behavioral expectedBehavior items should have corresponding rg/grep verification steps.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: features.json 'ws-endpoint-rewiring' verificationSteps: [rg OrchestrationSessionContext ..., rg 'fleet_rlm.(agent_host|worker)' ..., make test, make lint, make typecheck]. No step verifies event kinds emitted.

summary: FAIL. The feature was misscoped by the worker as a rename task (OrchestrationSessionContext → SessionContext) when the description required a substantive rewrite including (1) event type simplification and (2) factory.py rewired to FleetAgent. VAL-WS-002 (simplified event types) is entirely unaddressed — the streaming layer still emits trajectory_step, reasoning_step, final, cancelled, and other complex event kinds. factory.py still uses RLMReActChatAgent rather than the new FleetAgent. The feature's own verificationSteps lacked a check for event type simplification, which contributed to the gap going undetected. Both blocking issues need remediation before this feature can be considered complete.
